generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A schema-valid evidence package can retain required fields while replacing discriminant semantics with generic filler and one coarse green gate.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Generate negative controls from a generic template and reuse one aggregate CI summary as evidence for unrelated attack surfaces.

reusable_control.requirement: Reject semantic placeholders and require each material control to identify a discriminant attack plus scenario-specific provenance.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: When regenerating an adversarial matrix, preserve or improve semantic specificity and never replace scenario descriptions with generic filler.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail readiness when mandatory adversarial fields normalize to placeholders or a material control cannot be traced to an executable source exercising its dimension.

transfer_cases.scenario: Distinguish acceptance, confirmed delivery and failure with separate assertions.
Bind cross-tenant denial to a boundary/full-stack source proving foreign context is denied.

skill_changes.change: Require discriminant controls and scenario-specific provenance.
Reject known placeholder phrases and preserve regression coverage.
